item: I think that most people like some aspects of my personality.
Is curious about many different things.
I don’t pay attention to what I’m doing because I’m daydreaming, worrying, or otherwise distracted.
I seek out pleasure in life
Is persistent, works until the task is finished.
I am seeking a purpose or mission for my life.
When I am reading an interesting story or novel, I imagine how I would feel if the events in the story were happening to me.
I can close my eyes and easily picture a scene that I have experienced
When someone I know well is unhappy, I can almost feel that person's pain myself.
I care about what I am feeling
Is compassionate, has a soft heart.
I value my creativity and individuality
When I read, I tend to hear a voice in my "mind’s ear"
It helps to turn to my romantic partner in times of need.
Feels little sympathy for others.
How I dress is important to me.
I evaluate my behavior using my inner speech. For example I say to myself, “that was good” or “that was stupid”
In conversations‚ I am sensitive to even the slightest change in the facial expression of the person I’m conversing with.
I am aware of the way my mind works when I am thinking through a problem
Are you sometimes bubbling over with energy and sometimes very sluggish?
